objective: Build the job-intelligence and application-pack workers: JD analyzer, company/role research brief, CV-tailoring handoff, cover-letter handoff, independent truth/completeness review and deterministic owner submission gate.
prerequisites: Career Ops canonical job record and CV workflow source paths must be identified.
allowed_scope: Define a structured JobBrief schema: source/provenance, requirements, responsibilities, eligibility, useful keywords, risks/unknowns, company facts with citations/provenance where available.
Implement JD analysis without converting preferences into facts or inventing requirements.
Build a company/role research brief interface that can use web/browser tooling when available, and otherwise records research-needed rather than guessing.
Pass only source-supported facts into CV and cover-letter workflows; preserve canonical owner/profile data.
Implement an independent Application Pack Reviewer that checks truthfulness, requirement coverage, consistency, formatting/export readiness and unresolved unknowns.
Implement a Submission Gate that always requires owner approval before any external application action.
Run a representative local fixture/safe-data acceptance from job record -> JobBrief -> CV draft -> cover-letter draft -> reviewer -> owner gate.
stop_conditions: No secrets/private source dumps in GitHub.
notes: Part of the owner-mandated 2026-09-24 morning engineering cutoff. Continue independently around owner-only credential/admin blockers; record those in tasks-or-issues/overnight-owner-actions-2026-09-24.md. Do not duplicate equivalent pending/running work.
